newsitem.title: UK: Schoolboy, 11, is Britain's youngest known dad.
newsitem.headline: Schoolboy, 11, is Britain's youngest known dad.

text.p: An 11-year-old boy is about to become Britain's youngest known father after making his 15-year-old girlfriend pregnant, British newspapers reported on Monday.

Schoolboy Sean Stewart lives next door to girlfriend Emma Webster in the village of Sharnbrook, southeast England and neither family disputes that he is the father of the baby she is expecting in January.
Webster told the Daily Mail newspaper she planned to have the baby and hoped to return to school after the birth while her parents looked after the child.
She said she hoped Webster, whom she first thought was 15 years old, would want to remain involved in its upbringing.
"I think he will be a good father. He may only be 11 but he is quite mature and responsible for his age," she told the newspaper.
